products.name: Fresh Ricotta
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Calabro Cheese Co. - East Haven, CT
products.description: Calabro ricotta is a special cheese. The texture is impossibly light, fluffy and creamy. Flavors are milky, buttery & sweet. Once you try it, it will be impossible to go back to the generic tubs you find at your local grocery store. The curd is still hand-dipped and hand-packed into Calabro’s instantly recognizable metal containers that are pierced with tiny holes to allow the whey to drain, even after the cheese is shipped. Delicious when enjoyed as is, it is also an essential ingredient for your ravioli, lasagna and cannoli filling. If that's not all, it is also great for baking, or drizzling with honey for an amazing dessert.

products.name: Lioni Burrata con Panna, 8oz
products.tagline: Pastuerized Cow - Lioni Latticini - Union, New Jersey
products.description: The Salzarulo family moved from Lioni, Italy to Brooklyn, New York in 1980, where they founded Lioni Latticini. After decades of cheesemaking in Italy, they brought their expertise to the United States, and currently offer a range of exceptional fresh cheeses. Produced with a fusion of traditional techniques and modern technological precision, their products embody all the best qualities of fresh Italian cheese – mellow, delicate, yet still abundantly flavorful. This cow’s milk burrata is blissfully rich. The thin outer rind stretches around a filling of slightly sweet, creamy panna di latte and tender pasta filata mozzarella. Cut it open, and the interior spills out, instantly enriching your dish with a cascade of cream. This burrata will magically transform even the simplest salad into a summery delight!

products.name: Bocconcino di Langa
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Caseificio della'Alta Langa - Piedmont, Italy - 4oz
products.description: Meaning "little mouthful," Bocconcino is made with goat's milk that has been enriched with cream. It has a thin, soft, edible rind and a smooth ivory paste. Flavors include notes of tangy, fresh cream and subtle hints of grass. Enjoy with crusty bread at room temperature.

products.name: Persille de Rambouillet
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Ferme de la Tremblaye - Ile-de-France, France
products.description: This unbelievably smooth ash-coated goat milk blue comes from La Tremblaye dairy, located in the countryside surrounding Paris. Persille de Rambouillet gets its name from its “parsley-veined” interior—persille—and the Rambouillet forest adjacent to the dairy’s picturesque farmland. With a supple texture and notes of white pepper and sweet cream, this blue is, well...amazing. Huge staff favorite!

products.name: Belgioso Burrata
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - BelGioioso - Green Bay, WI - 8oz
products.description: Traditionally from Puglia in southern Italy, this is one of the freshest of all cow's milk cheeses. Milky, sweet, fresh mozzarella on the outside, with molten ribbons of curd and cream on the inside. Each 8oz package contains two 4oz pieces of burrata packed in water for optimum storage. Drizzle with olive oil and a pinch of sea salt and serve with crusty bread. You can work up from there by adding any of the following: grilled bread, prosciutto, salame, sliced tomatoes, fresh herbs, grilled vegetables, aged balsamic or sauteed rapini.

products.name: Bellwether Farms Creme Fraiche
products.description: Family owned and operated, Bellwether Farms is located in Sonoma County, California, about an hour north of San Francisco and a few miles from the Pacific Ocean. Their award-winning French-style cultured cream has a rich, nutty flavor with an appealing tart finish. Works perfectly for savory & sweet applications. Great for enriching soups, sauces, pastry, pies & berries!

products.name: Bezi Original Labneh
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Bezi - New York, NY
products.description: Co-founders Ilay and Hasan grew up eating labneh at breakfast and dreamed of making it a staple in every American kitchen. Labneh is a creamy, spreadable dairy dip traditionally enjoyed across the Middle East and Mediterranean. Ilay, a McKinsey consultant turned cheesemaker, moved to New York from Istanbul to pursue her MBA. During that time, she followed her passion and worked on a farm milking cows and sheep and learned the art of making cheese from scratch. Hasan, on the other hand, is a Berkeley engineer and an heir to one of Turkey's largest cheesemaking families. His grandfather, known as "The Cheese King" in Turkey, built the Bahcivan Gida factory from the ground up, transforming it into an empire. Their paths serendipitously crossed at a previous job where they bonded over a shared passion for dairy. Together, they embarked on a mission to make labneh a thing in the US and created BEZI: the labneh that labnehs better than any other labneh out there. High in protein, low in tang, and ready to party!

products.name: Buche Maitre Seguin
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Soignon - Poitou-Charentes, France
products.description: Balanced and smooth, Buche Maitre Seguin ripens into three distinct textures. The outer rind is thick and fluffy, while the creamline directly underneath gets soft and oozy. The inner paste is dense and chalky. Bright and lemony in flavor, this cheese is as at home on a cheese board as it is on a fresh green salad.

products.name: Buf Buffalo Burrata
products.tagline: Pasteurized Buffalo - Buf Creamery - El Rosal, Columbia - 8oz
products.description: Imported from the Columbia...yes, that's right, Columbia. Trust us, if it wasn't really good, we wouldn't be selling it. You love burrata, we know this. You also love mozzarella di bufula. Well, time for these two to meet. Buf's Burrata di Bufula combines two great things - the bright, tangy of buffalo milk and the molten texture of fresh burrata. Each package contains one, 8oz piece of fresh burrata di bufala packed in water for optimum storage.

products.name: Buf Mozzarella di Bufala
products.tagline: Pasteurized Buffalo - Buf - El Rosal, Columbia - 8oz
products.description: Imported from the Columbia...yes, that's right, Columbia. Trust us, if it wasn't really good, we wouldn't be selling it. Mozzarella di Bufala is wonderfully fresh and delicate with a pleasant tang. This is the perfect cheese to use on your Pizza Margherita, in a salad or with other classic Italian recipes. Each package contains one, 8oz piece of fresh mozzarella packed in water for optimum storage. Voted the #1 Mozzarella in 2016 by the American Cheese Society.

products.name: Cheesella di Bufala
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow & Buffalo - Guffanti - Campania, Italy
products.description: What happens when two spectacular cheesemaking traditions meet? When legendary mozzarella (made with buffalo milk) is literally preserved in the rich, stretched-curd cheese of Caciocavallo? Fresh and aged? One answer: the fabulous Cheesella di Bufala. A novelty with over 200 years of history behind it! With it's lactic and buttery taste, Cheesella di Bufala is perfect for pizzas and pastas. Buy it by the whole, half or quarter wheel - all priced by the pound. Each wheel is approximately 1.3 lbs. Like with our other cheeses sold by the wedge, the actual price will be determined when we put it on the scale.

products.name: DeLaurenti Pimento Cheese Spread
products.tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti kitchen!
products.description: Our take on this Southern classic is a little bit savory, a little bit smoky, and delightfully spicy. Made in our kitchen using New School American Cheese, spicy peppadews, and smoked paprika. Perfect for scooping with a cracker, spicing up your grilled cheese, or adding some kick to your burger!

products.name: Dorstone, 8oz
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Neal's Yard Dairy - Herefordshire UK
products.description: Named after the Village of Dorstone above the River Wye in England, this ash-ripened goat's milk cheese is made in the style of classic French goat cheeses. Aged for only 3 to 4 weeks, Dorstone has a fluffy interior and a thin, delicate rind with a lightly acidic and citrusy flavor.

products.name: FETA Voras 2/4.4#
products.tagline: Pasteurized Sheep/Goat - Essex St. Cheese/Tastanis - Florina, Greece
products.description: Feta Voras is made in the far Northwestern corner of Greece, in the province of Florina using mostly sheep's milk and a small amount of goat's milk. This is mountainous land, covered in wildflowers and herbs. The small third generation firm, run by brothers Andreas and Sokratis, makes a creamy, crumbly cheese that you’ll want as a staple in your home. Mount Voras is one of Greece’s highest peaks and its nearby slopes make up the grazing ground for the sheep whose milk becomes Feta Voras. Florina is one of the seven regions that can make traditoinal PDO feta. It’s made in small blocks, sprinkled with sea salt from the port of Patras, aged for about three months, then sliced into wedges and packed up for shipment to New York.

products.name: Florette
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Fromagerie Guilloteau - Rhone-Alps, France
products.description: Love brie but in the mood for something a bit less barnyard and a bit more bright? Look no further. Florette combines the creamy, lush texture of it's cow's milk cousin with the bright piquancy of goat cheese. Ivory white in color with a ultra-creamy, spreadable texture, this cheese is a perfect gateway goat.

products.name: Fresh Buffalo Ricotta
products.tagline: Pasteurized Buffalo - Calabro Cheese Co. - East Haven, CT
products.description: If you like Calabro's award winning fresh ricotta, you will love their equally as delicious fresh Buffalo Ricotta! It is similar to the cow's milk version with a light, smooth & delicate texture, but with the hallmark tang of fresh buffalo milk. Perfect for filling ravioli, for bruschetta with honey or lasagna!

products.name: Fresh Mozzarella
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Grande Cheese Co. - Brownsville, WI
products.description: Originally made using water buffalo's milk, the cow's milk version is perfect for your Caprese Salad or Pizza Margherita. Slice into medallions and drizzle with olive oil and a pinch of sea salt for a simple, but satisfying appetizer. Four rounds to a pound, each piece is packed in a little water for freshness. Feel free to add a little tap water for storage. Before using it on pizza, drain the water and let the cheese rest in the fridge for an hour. Pour off excess water (this would have wound up in the middle of your pizza), use and enjoy!

products.name: Gina Marie Cream Cheese
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Sierra Nevada Cheese Co. - Willows, CA
products.description: Gina Marie is the original natural cream cheese. With all due respect to the mass produced cream cheese that you find at your local grocery store, there really is no comparison. Made using only milk, cream, and salt, this cheese is void of any fillers, stabilizers, and gums. Light and fluffy in texture, fresh and creamy in flavor, use it liberally whenever you have a craving for cream cheese.

products.name: Gina Marie Farmer's Cheese
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Sierra Nevada Cheese Co. - Willows, CA
products.description: Use this Fresh Russian-Style Farmers Cheese as a filling for blintzes, lasagna, or filled pasta. Make a cheesecake or other baked desserts, spread on toast or bagels. It has half the fat of our Gina Marie Cream Cheese with all the probiotic benefits of kefir cultures. Light, creamy and mild, it is perfect for all your sweet & savory recipes!

products.name: Halloumi, 6oz
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Lost Peacock Creamery - Olympia, Washington
products.description: Lost Peacock Creamery is a Grade A Goat Dairy and Farmstead Cheesemaking Operation in Olympia, Washington. Halloumi is bright white, with a mozzarella-like texture and a light, salty flavor. Cut into batons, put it on a skewer, and cook it directly on the grill until charred and warm. Don't worry, Halloumi's strong, rigid network of protein will keep it from melting into the coals. Enjoy as is topped with fresh herbs, add the grilled cheese to the top of a salad, or crumble into an omelette. For the colder months, fry the cheese lightly in olive oil in your favorite saute pan. Lost Peacock's Halloumi is a delightfully crispy on the outside, gooey on the inside, squeaks in your mouth, bit of perfection. This cheese was made to be the star of the show!

products.name: Humboldt Fog
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Cypress Grove Chevre - Arcata, CA
products.description: A pioneer in American cheese-making since the 1980s, Cypress Grove Chevre helped redefine what many Americans recognized as cheese. Humboldt Fog is their award winning flagship cheese. Each handcrafted wheel features a distinctive ribbon of edible vegetable ash. You'll enjoy flavors of buttermilk and fresh cream, complemented with floral notes, herbaceous overtones, and a clean citrus finish. As Humboldt Fog matures, the creamline develops and the flavor intensifies.

products.name: Idaho Grilling Cheese, 8oz
products.tagline: Pasteruized Cow - Ballard Cheese - Gooding, ID
products.description: Stacie and Steve Ballard, started their 35-acre farm in Gooding, Idaho in 1995. Steve wanted to start a dairy farm despite not having any personal experience in part because other family members were already in the farming business. Steve and his son Travis had both worked with heavy mechanical equipment and were good with their hands. Those skills were indispensable to the success of the farm. The family diversified into cheesemaking with Travis in 2004 to add more value to their milk and diversify from the volatile milk market. Their Idaho Grilling Cheese is a traditional semi-firm Mediterranean grilling cheese with a distinctive layered texture. It is mildly salty with a rich buttery taste. Idaho Grilling Cheese can withstand a tremendous amount of heat without melting. It develops a delicious golden crust when grilled, BBQ'd, or fried. A must-try for fans of Halloumi!

products.name: Leonora
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Fancendera/Mitica - Leon, Spain
products.description: Leonora is a goat's milk cheese produced in the mountainous region of Leon in northwestern Spain. Known for its distinctive loaf shape, the interior paste is bone white with a dense cakey texture toward the middle and a silky cream line just under the rind. Flavors are bright and creamy with a pleasant lemony tang.

products.name: Lost Peacock Fresh Chevre
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Lost Peacock - Olympia, WA
products.description: Lost Peacock Creamery is a wife & husband Grade A creamery in Olympia, WA. When in doubt, go local. Especially when it comes to rich, creamy, fresh chevre. Happy goats make great milk. Great milk makes great cheese. It's safe to say that the 3 dozen grass pasture fed goats have a great life. Spread this seasonal chevre on crostini, fold it into fresh pasta with herbs, dot it on your pizza or crumble it on your wild green salad!

products.name: Meredith Dairy Marinated Feta
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat/Sheep - Meredith Dairy - Meredith, Australia
products.description: Yes, Australians can make great cheese, too. These delicate little white cubes of spreadable goat/sheep farmstead cheese are a customer favorite in our cheese case. Marinated in olive oil with sprigs of thyme and cracked black pepper, they are perfect to spread on grilled bread or set aloft a handful of fresh, wild greens or grilled vegetables.

products.name: Monte Enebro
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Rafael Baez - Castille-Lyon, Spain
products.description: Made in Avila, Spain, by legendary cheesemaker Rafael Baez and his daughter Paloma, Monte Enebro is a goat's milk cheese made in a distinct log shape. Its name translates to Juniper Hill, referring to the bountiful juniper plants surrounding the dairy. The cheese is coated in penicilium roqueforti, the mold that makes blue cheeses blue. When young, the interior paste of the cheese is pure white and slightly chalky and brittle in texture. With age, the paste tends to break down and become runny and almost translucent just under the rind. Flavors in the younger cheeses are mild, bright and tangy, with distinct citrus notes combined with a cellar-like aroma and flavor imparted by the blue rind. As the cheeses mature, the aromas become more pungent and the flavors evolve and strengthen, becoming quite assertive, tasting of barnyard and goat. Perfect with Sauternes or Spanish dessert wine.

products.name: Nocciolo
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow/Goat/Sheep - Caseificio dell'Alta Langa - Piedmont, Italy
products.description: Il Nocciola, meaning hazelnut in Italian, is a beautiful cow/goat/sheep combo from Northern Italy's Piedmont region. It is sweet, buttery, bright & impossibly creamy. Despite it's diminutive stature, it brings maximum impact. It's hard to find anyone who doesn't love this cheese, especially when you hand them a glass of bubbly to go with it!

products.name: Petite Pave de Paris
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow/Goat - Ferme de la Tremblaye - Ile-de-France, France
products.description: Made to resemble the iconic paving stones of Paris, Petite Pavé de Paris is a masterpiece of sustainable farming and artisanal cheesemaking from Ferme de la Tremblaye. From its appearance to its flavor, this is truly a unique cheese. The square shape and ashed rind give the cheese its Parisian cobblestone appearance. The paste of the cheese is mottled buttery yellow and ivory thanks to the alternating layers of cow’s milk curd and goat’s milk curd. Petite Pavé de Paris is tart and fruity with a mineral finish, the perfect complement to a light and bright wine!

products.name: Shabby Shoe
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Blakesville Creamery - Port Washington, WI
products.description: Blakesville Creamery is a farmstead creamery, meaning the cheeses are made by hand on the same farm where the animals are raised and their milk is collected. Their goal is to humanely raise healthy goats using sustainable farming practices and to produce the highest quality of handmade artisan cheeses. Because of this, care and attention to the purity, quality, and flavor of the milk are critical to the production process. Their cheeses are ripened naturally, focusing on developing characteristic flavor and texture and eschewing shortcuts or techniques that would affect quality. Despite the grungy name, this cheese is pristine! An homage to the French Chabichou (pronounced, you guessed it, "shabby shoe"), Shabby Shoe nails the thin wrinkled rind, gooey creamline, and incredibly light texture of the original. The taste is bright, featuring notes of citrus, sweet cream, and grass, with a short, clean finish–reminiscent of fleeting clouds on a summer day. With this delicate chèvre, Blakesville Creamery connects the dots between the Loire Valley and the shores of Lake Michigan. One bite and you'll understand why Shabby Shoe has quickly become a staff favorite!

products.name: Tomme de Chevre Grand-Mere
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Fromagerie P. Jacquin - Loire, France
products.description: Located in the Centre-Val de Loire, Fromagerie Pascal Jacquin et Fils has specialized in making and aging the region’s traditional and exemplary goat’s milk cheeses since 1947. “Grandmother Adrienne” is a beautifully bloomed goat cheese. It has a fudgy texture towards the center and a runny, silky cream line. Flavors of buttermilk, lemon and faint minerality, make it perfect for a cheese course or simple meal with a fresh salad, bread and a crisp white from the Loire.
